entities.summary: Jenly Tegu Wini is Solomon Islander weightlifter. She competed in the 2012 Summer Olympics in the women's 58 kg category. She was the flagbearer of the Solomon Islands sports team in the opening ceremony. In the event, Wini finished in the 17th place.
